exercise.title: Say the name, then check
exercise.why: Saying the name before you see the answers makes you pull it from memory, and a name you have pulled from memory a few times stops needing to be counted.

cells.text:
Press Start in the game below. The game lights a note on the neck: say its name out loud first, then press that name under the neck to check.
Keep going until some names come before you can count up to them.
